name: dsh-knit
description: Find the doc your agent just wrote. Lists the DSH workspace's Markdown, images and video in the sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation, with inline preview — and hands the same ranking to the agent as a tool, returning the passage that matched in each document. Zero model calls, zero network.
